Automatic transmission AL4 is screw lubricated.

When servicing, it may be necessary to fully or partly drain the system:- 4 litres emerges during the full drainage operation;- 1.5 litres emerges when the hydraulic unit casing is removed;- 4.5 litres emerges when the hydraulic unit is removed;- 5 litres emerges when the torque converter is removed.The system must be drained with the transmission fluid warm.

Position a container to collect the automatic transmission fluid.

Do not let the oil disperse into the atmosphere as this could cause pollution.

Versions with steel plug/level

In versions with this configuration, the steel drain plug (a) also performs the oil level function and includes a plug (b) to control this level.

1. Undo the plug (27 mm hexagonal wrench) and drain the transmission fluid.

Versions with polyamide drain plug

In versions with this configuration, the steel oil level check plug (A) is separated from the polyamide drain plug.

1. Unscrew the level check plug (1a) (8 mm box wrench), unscrew polyamide drain plug (1b) (8 mm hexagonal wrench) and drain the transmission fluid.

Versions with steel plug/level
